ministry_or_dept: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSME) Coir Board
summary_en: A women-exclusive self-employment scheme supporting rural women artisans in coir-producing regions with two months of training (₹1,000/month stipend) and a 75% subsidy (up to ₹7,500) to purchase motorised or electronic coir spinning equipment.
embedding_text: Mahila Coir Yojana supports rural women artisans in coir-producing regions through two months of skill training with a 1000 rupee monthly stipend and subsidised spinning equipment. Helps women start coir yarn, rope, mat, and coconut fibre businesses using motorised ratt, traditional ratt, or electronic ratt machines with 75 percent subsidy up to 7500 rupees (3200 rupees ceiling for select traditional/electronic ratts).

ministry_or_dept: National Scheduled Tribes Finance and Development Corporation (NSTFDC), Ministry of Tribal Affairs
summary_en: An exclusive concessional term-loan scheme for individual Scheduled Tribe women providing up to 90% financing for viable income-generating units costing up to ₹2 lakh (maximum loan ₹1.8 lakh), at 4% annual interest for loans up to ₹1 lakh (higher slab rates vary by State Channelising Agency).
embedding_text: Adivasi Mahila Sashaktikaran Yojana AMSY by NSTFDC provides concessional term loans exclusively to individual Scheduled Tribe women entrepreneurs through State Channelising Agencies. Supports self-employment and income-generating micro units such as tailoring, agriculture, retail shops, handicrafts, livestock, and small manufacturing up to 2 lakh project cost with 90 percent loan assistance (up to 1.8 lakh) and 4 percent interest for loans up to 1 lakh.

ministry_or_dept: North Eastern Development Finance Corporation Ltd. (NEDFi)
summary_en: Provides term loans up to 75% of project cost (maximum loan ₹11.25 lakh on a ₹15 lakh maximum project cost) at up to 8% annual interest for skilled women entrepreneurs in North Eastern India, with up to 84 months repayment, 6 months moratorium, nil processing fee, and a 1% upfront fee.
embedding_text: NEDFI Loan for Women Entrepreneurs offers concessional term loans up to 11.25 lakh (75 percent of 15 lakh maximum project cost) at up to 8 percent interest for skilled women aged 18 to 50 in North East India. Covers new or existing MSMEs in handloom, handicraft, food processing, retail, agriculture, manufacturing, and services with 25 percent promoter margin, 84 months repayment, 6 months moratorium, nil processing fee, and 1 percent upfront fee.

ministry_or_dept: Ministry of Commerce and Industry / Government e-Marketplace (GeM)
summary_en: A public procurement and digital market-access initiative enabling women-owned MSEs and women SHGs to sell products and services directly to government ministries and CPSEs under a 3% annual procurement target.
embedding_text: Womaniya on GeM is a government e-marketplace initiative helping women-owned micro and small enterprises and women SHGs sell goods and services directly to government buyers and public sector undertakings. Supports B2G e-commerce onboarding, product cataloguing, and participation in the 3 percent public procurement mandate without middlemen.

ministry_or_dept: National Cooperative Development Corporation (NCDC), Ministry of Cooperation
summary_en: An NCDC framework for women-led cooperatives (at least 50% women primary members) offering project finance (70:30 pattern for infrastructure; 80:20 debt-equity for new/innovative projects), business-plan handholding, and 2% interest subvention for new/innovative activities (1% for other activities), with project-cost bands of up to ₹1 crore (>3 months–1 year), up to ₹3 crore (1–3 years), and uncapped (>3 years).
embedding_text: Nandini Sahakar by NCDC supports registered women cooperative societies with at least 50 percent women primary members across India (excluding urban housing). Project-cost bands are up to 1 crore for societies operating more than 3 months to under 1 year, up to 3 crore for 1 to 3 years, and uncapped over 3 years. Offers 70:30 infrastructure loans, 80:20 new/innovative financing, and 1 to 2 percent interest subvention.

title_en: DAY-NRLM Women SHG Bank Credit and Interest Subvention
summary_en: A group-based bank linkage framework (where the rural women SHG is the principal borrower, not an individual direct applicant) providing collateral-free credit up to ₹20 lakh in corpus-linked repeat doses, with FY 2025–26 RBI interest subvention setting a 7% rate for loans up to ₹3 lakh and benchmark/10% cap for ₹3–5 lakh (confirm FY 2026–27 terms with the bank).
embedding_text: DAY-NRLM Women SHG Bank Credit is a group-based framework where rural women Self-Help Groups are the principal borrowers, not individual applicants. Provides collateral-free loans up to 20 lakh (no margin up to 10 lakh) in repeat doses based on corpus and Micro Credit Plan. Under FY 2025-26 RBI norms, loans up to 3 lakh carry 7 percent interest and 3 to 5 lakh are capped at benchmark or 10 percent (verify FY 2026-27 rates).

ministry_or_dept: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSME)
summary_en: Supports traditional artisans and craftspeople across 18 notified trades with a ₹15,000 toolkit e-voucher, skill training (₹500/day stipend), and collateral-free loans up to ₹3 lakh at a 5% interest rate.
embedding_text: PM Vishwakarma supports self-employed traditional artisans and women craftspeople in 18 trades including tailoring, pottery, basket and mat weaving, coir weaving, doll making, garland making, goldsmithing, carpentry, and cobbling. Offers 15000 rupee toolkit voucher, 500 rupee daily training stipend, and collateral-free loans up to 3 lakh at 5 percent interest.

ministry_or_dept: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSME) / KVIC
summary_en: A credit-linked margin-money subsidy programme for setting up eligible new non-farm micro-enterprises (up to ₹50 lakh project cost for manufacturing and ₹20 lakh for business/services), offering women special-category subsidies of 35% (rural) or 25% (urban) routed through the lending bank with 5% own contribution and bank-specific interest rates.
embedding_text: PMEGP Prime Minister Employment Generation Programme provides bank-routed margin-money subsidies for setting up new non-farm micro-enterprises (existing units excluded from normal first loans). Women receive 35 percent subsidy in rural areas and 25 percent in urban areas with 5 percent own contribution, on project-cost ceilings of 50 lakh for manufacturing and 20 lakh for business or services, at bank-applicable interest rates.

Supports self-employment ventures such as tailoring, beauty parlours, retail shops, food stalls, handicrafts, and small service businesses for families earning under 3 lakh.
